# Classic Bluedroid ↔ RW-BT HCI compatibility matrix

**The first deterministic startup stall is `0x1005 Read Buffer Size`.** Bluedroid sends it immediately after Reset. OpenFW submits `E05C` to the controller, but its HCI task has no case that returns the result to the host. The default case consumes the message. Fixing only `g_openfw_cmd_tbl` leaves this stall intact. A second, later enable dependency is easy to miss: BTA reads the **local name** specifically to sequence `BTA_DM_ENABLE_EVT`. `device/controller.c:251–265`, `open_fw/src/bt_hci.c:741–752,849–852,889–891`, `bta/dm/bta_dm_act.c:578–585`.

## Reading the tables

- Bluedroid references are relative to `components/bt/host/bluedroid` at the supplied `ad20ded6` checkout. In the tables, `F` = `open_fw/src/bt_hci.c`, `C` = `device/controller.c`, `U` = `stack/btu/btu_hcif.c`, `I` = `stack/btm/btm_inq.c`, `A` = `stack/btm/btm_acl.c`, `S` = `stack/btm/btm_sec.c`, `D` = `stack/btm/btm_devctl.c`, `P` = `stack/btm/btm_pm.c`. The command builder in this revision is `stack/hcic/hcicmds.c`, e.g. `:63,175,1341,1731`.
- Opcodes and `OGF/OCF` are hexadecimal. `CC` means Command Complete, with `Num_HCI_Command_Packets:u8, opcode:u16` followed by the listed return parameters. `s` = status byte, `h` = 16-bit handle, `a` = six-byte address in HCI wire order. `CS → xx` means Command Status (`s, command credits:u8, opcode:u16`) followed, on a successful start, by the indicated asynchronous event. Multibyte integers are little-endian. A command reply with the wrong opcode can be as damaging as silence. `F:672–697`, `hci/hci_layer.c:572–594,600–641`.
- **Risk applies to every command row.** An unanswered ordinary command can block subsequent commands when the advertised credit is one, as it is in OpenFW. The HCI timeout logs the opcode and does not resolve the pending future. Every `C` startup row is awaited. Returning CS for an awaited CC does not resolve that future either. Runtime rows additionally name the procedure affected. `0C35` is the explicit no-ack exception. `F:672–695`, `C:237,251`, `hci/hci_layer.c:338,423–429,513–521,594–619`.
- In the glue column, **mapped** means the request and initial reply both have OpenFW cases. **TX only** means the request has a case but its initial reply does not. **Missing** means OpenFW has no command-table entry. A hex ID on a missing row is a **stock dispatch-table candidate**, not a tested handler. I decoded the little-endian entries in `dumps/firmware_2M.bin` at file offset `base + 2 × (OCF − 1)`: bases `0xD6A28` for OGF 01, `0xD6810` for 02, `0xD6854` for 03, `0xD6B20` for 04. These reproduce the known OpenFW anchors including `0405→E004`, `0406→E400`, `0C13→E025`, `1005→E05C`, and `1009→E05D`. The separate stock opcode list is visible at `0x444B8`; presence there does not establish a nonzero KE dispatch entry. `F:882–903`, `docs/FIRMWARE_ANALYSIS.md:524`.
- Scope is the stated profiles and procedures, including conditional branches for peer capabilities, pairing method, cancellation and shutdown. It is a static analysis, not a board trace. Classic security dispatch in this fork also depends on `SMP_INCLUDED`; the proposed build must retain `UC_BT_SMP_ENABLE` even with BLE off. Otherwise PIN/key events and authentication/encryption processing are compiled out. `common/include/common/bt_target.h:642–651`, `U:332–352,398–409`.

## Controller startup, in actual send order

| Opcode · OGF/OCF | Command and Bluedroid send site | OpenFW today / stock KE candidate | Required response and particular risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0C03` · `03/003` | Reset · `C:251` | Synthetic `E07A` CC, `F:743,909–915` | CC `s`. Current path reports success without resetting live links, masks or flow state. Cold enable and re-enable need separate consideration. |
| `1005` · `04/005` | Read Buffer Size · `C:256` | **TX only** `E05C`, `F:890,741–852` | CC `s, ACL_len:u16, SCO_len:u8, ACL_count:u16, SCO_count:u16`. All seven bytes after status are read, even without SCO. Zero ACL credits also prevent useful streaming. |
| `0C31` · `03/031` | Set Controller To Host Flow Control · `C:262–265` | Missing `E03D` | CC `s`. ACL flow control is compiled on in this tree. Accepting it commits the transport to respecting host receive credits. `common/include/common/bt_target.h:1633`. |
| `0C33` · `03/033` | Host Buffer Size · `C:274–285` | Missing `E03E` | CC `s`. **Unconditional** here. The command supplies ACL length, SCO length, ACL count and SCO count. Keep the ACL limits for controller→host delivery. `hci/hci_packet_factory.c:69–80`. |
| `1001` · `04/001` | Read Local Version Information · `C:289` | **TX only** `E058`, `F:889,741–852` | CC `s, HCI_version:u8, HCI_revision:u16, LMP_version:u8, manufacturer:u16, LMP_subversion:u16`. Padding in a native struct breaks the read. |
| `1009` · `04/009` | Read BD_ADDR · `C:293` | Mapped `E05D→E0C0`, `F:748,891` | CC `s,a`. Use the controller's stable identity and wire byte order. |
| `1002` · `04/002` | Read Local Supported Commands · `C:297` | Missing `E059` | CC `s, bitmap[64]`. A short or failed response can assert. Advertising an unimplemented operation creates later failures. |
| `1004` · `04/004` | Read Local Extended Features · `C:307,348` | Missing; stock OGF 04 slot `0xD6B26` is zero. KE ID **unknown - needs hardware probe**. | CC `s, requested_page:u8, max_page:u8, features[8]`. First returned page must be 0. Later replies must advance with the request and stay within the host array. Page 1 can depend on the intervening SSP write. |
| `0C56` · `03/056` | Write Simple Pairing Mode · `C:321–329` | Mapped `E04F→E0B1`, `F:747,888` | CC `s`. Sent when local page 0 advertises SSP and host SSP is enabled. Failure leaves the controller and host disagreeing about pairing mode. |
| `0C7A` · `03/07A` | Write Secure Connections Host Support · `C:361–365` | Missing; **unknown - needs hardware probe** | CC `s`. Only if configured **and** page 2 advertises controller SC. Keep that bit clear for an unverified BT 4.0 controller. SSP alone does not trigger this command. |
| `0C01` · `03/001` | Set Event Mask · `C:35–40,474–475` | Mapped `E01C→E079`, `F:742,883` | CC `s`. Final awaited command in the no-SCO build. Apply the eight mask bytes so the enabled remote-feature and pairing events can actually arrive. |

The synchronous parser checks the event type and minimum parameter length **before** inspecting status. Buffer size, version, address and supported-commands reads then assert that the returned stream is non-null. A status-only Unknown HCI Command CC is therefore unsafe for these reads. Extended Features has an error branch, but the same minimum-length check precedes it. Generic write completions log a nonzero status and free the reply. `hci/hci_packet_parser.c:33–54,57–95,109–130,276–303`. `1003 Read Local Supported Features` has a factory and parser but this Classic startup path requests **`1004`**, even for page 0. `hci/hci_packet_factory.c:93–109`, `C:305–316`.

Bluedroid marks it `NOACK` and bypasses the pending-command path. `hci/hci_layer.c:423–429`. |
| `0807` · `02/007` | QoS Setup, **explicit GAP QoS request only** · `btc/profile/std/gap/btc_gap_bt.c:1095`, `bta/dm/bta_dm_qos.c:46`, `A:2085` | Missing `E411` | CS → `0D` QoS Setup Complete. Enabling A2DP/AVRCP/SPP alone does not take this send path. |

**Profile boundary.** The A2DP PM configuration selects sniff and sets sniff subrating off. The subrating sender exists (`0811`, stock `E416`, CC `s,h`), but I found no requirement for an automatic subrating, Hold, Park or HCI Flow Specification command from the stated profiles. `P:330,708–739`, `bta/dm/bta_dm_cfg.c:214–225`, `common/include/common/bt_target.h:1587`. AVDTP media, AVRCP, SDP, L2CAP signalling and RFCOMM use **H4 ACL data**. The data path must preserve handle, PB flags and fragment boundaries. OpenFW currently caps host→controller ACL payloads at 1021 bytes, routes them to `E426`, and can fail EM allocation. Its reverse path fragments using the configured host length, then its existing EIF consumer feeds only the selected handle to `bt_spp_on_acl_rx`. `F:583–625,958–992,1692–1713`.

**Shutdown.** BTA disables discoverability/connectability, stops PM, cancels active discovery and waits for links to go down, with a teardown timer. Depending on active state this reuses scan writes, inquiry/name cancellation, profile ACL traffic and Disconnect above. The controller module's own `shut_down()` only clears `readable`; there is no unconditional shutdown HCI Reset in that function. `bta/dm/bta_dm_act.c:624–645,667–676,697–720`, `C:489–492`.

## Controller-to-host event matrix

“Packed” establishes a KE-to-HCI conversion in the current firmware. It does **not** establish that every peer procedure produces the message on hardware, or that Bluedroid can receive it today. Current `eif_write` dispatches H4 events and ACL packets to the handwritten host. “Missing” means the glue has no matching event packer and consumes unmatched messages at `F:851–852`; the ROM producer/indication ID is **unknown - needs hardware probe** unless an ID is shown. The host checks the HCI event length against the actual buffer before dispatch. `F:849–862,1692–1714`, `U:303–309`.

| Event | Bluedroid consumer | OpenFW today | Host dependency / essential parameters |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0E` Command Complete | `hci/hci_layer.c:572–594`, `U:1282` | Partial, `F:672–683,742–755` | Correct opcode, current command credit, command-specific return data. One generic success packet cannot satisfy all reads. |
| `0F` Command Status | `hci/hci_layer.c:600–641`, `U:374` | Partial, accept/reject/disconnect only, `F:685–697,757–761` | `s,credits,opcode`. Required even where a terminal procedure event already has a packer. |
| `13` Number Of Completed Packets | `U:389,2053–2061` | Packed `E462`, `F:817–832` | `n,(h,count) × n`. Replenishes **host→controller** ACL credits. With no event, streaming runs for one controller buffer window and stops. |
| `01` Inquiry Complete | `U:310` | Missing | `s`; ends a normally completed inquiry even with zero results. |
| `02` Inquiry Result | `U:313` | Missing | Count plus standard BR result records, including peer address, scan information, class and clock offset. |
| `22` Inquiry Result with RSSI | `U:316` | Missing | Use the RSSI result layout; retain signed RSSI and correct per-result offsets. |
| `2F` Extended Inquiry Result | `U:319` | Missing | One response with address, scan fields, class, clock offset, RSSI and 240-byte EIR. HCI parameter length is 255. |
| `04` Connection Request | `U:325` | Packed `E457`, `F:774` | `a,class[3],link_type`. Give Bluedroid ownership of the accept/reject decision. |
| `03` Connection Complete | `U:322` | Packed `E0D2/E456`, `F:763–772` | `s,h,a,link_type,encryption_enabled`. Needed for both incoming and outgoing connections. |
| `05` Disconnection Complete | `U:329` | Packed `E458`, `F:775–781` | `s,h,reason`; releases link state and permits disable to finish. |
| `06` Authentication Complete | `U:332–336` | Packed `E459`, `F:783–788` | `s,h`; distinct from Simple Pairing Complete. |
| `07` Remote Name Request Complete | `U:338` | Missing | `s,a,name[248]`; full successful event has 255 parameter bytes. |
| `08` Encryption Change | `U:342–346` | Packed `E45A`, `F:790–796` | `s,h,encryption_enabled`. Deliver the real result before the host grants secured-channel access. |

`30` Encryption Key Refresh Complete is inside a **BLE compile guard** in this fork. `2C/2D` synchronous-connection events have switch cases, but the stated no-SCO profile set has no procedure requiring them. `U:347–354,435–440`. The transport must accommodate **259-byte H4 events** (`1 type + 2 header + 255 parameters` is **258 bytes**; a 259-byte buffer is sufficient). In particular, an 8-bit total packet-length calculation would truncate Extended Inquiry Result and Remote Name Request Complete. `U:303–319,338`, `F:738–739,855–861`.

## Prioritized shim work

| Priority | Command/event | Minimal behavior |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | H4 ownership, Reset, CC/CS | Deliver H4 event/ACL packets to Bluedroid in place of the handwritten `eif_write` consumers. Remove the second Reset/name/scan/SSP command chain from this mode. Give each accepted ordinary command exactly its specified initial reply and a usable command credit. Keep synthetic Reset only where the shim can establish clean reset state, including on a second enable. `F:672–695,909–915,1541–1562,1677–1683,1692–1714,2070`. |
| 2 | `1005` Read Buffer Size | First repair after Reset. Forward `E05C` and explicitly pack its ROM return fields, or synthesize verified transport limits. The repo documents 1021-byte ACL packets × 9 buffers; the glue independently enforces the length limit. Validate usable count before advertising nine. `C:256–260`, `F:958–964`, `docs/FIRMWARE_ANALYSIS.md:524`. |
| 3 | `0C31`, `0C33`, `0C35` controller→host credits | Implement these together. Forward the stock candidates only after verifying they update the state used by the new H4 delivery path; otherwise own the accounting in the shim. Enforce host packet length **and count**, restore credits by handle on `0C35`, and emit no success reply for it. Existing transmit code visibly uses host length. `C:262–285`, `F:583–619`, `stack/hcic/hcicmds.c:1338–1352`. |
| 4 | `1001`, `1009` identity | Forward the reads. Add the version CC packer; retain the address packer. Verify width, endian order and stability across reset. `F:748,889–891`, `hci/hci_packet_parser.c:57–82`. |
| 5 | `1002` Supported Commands | Forward `E059` if verified, then mask the 64-byte bitmap to the implemented HAL surface. A shim-owned bitmap is also viable. Always return the whole field. `C:297–301`, `hci/hci_packet_parser.c:85–95`, `docs/FIRMWARE_ANALYSIS.md:524`. |
| 6 | `1004`, `0C56`, `0C01` features, SSP and event mask | Synthesize coherent feature pages if no stock `1004` path is established. Retain verified BR/EDR and SSP bits, clear spurious LE/unsupported SC bits, echo the requested page, and reflect the SSP host setting on page 1. Forward the existing SSP-mode and mask writes. `C:305–329,348–365,474–475`, `F:742,747,1273–1274`, `docs/FIRMWARE_ANALYSIS.md:524`. |
| 7 | BTA setup writes and `0C14` Read Local Name | Forward the supported page-timeout, scan and policy writes with real completions. Maintain a 248-byte shim name initialized at reset and updated on successful `0C13`, or forward a verified controller read. This gets BTA through its distinct enable callback barrier. `bta/dm/bta_dm_act.c:570–585`, `D:589–597`, `U:1308–1312`. |
| 8 | `0C05`, `0401`, `0402`, `01/02/22/2F` discovery | Forward real filter/inquiry/cancel operations and pack their replies, result variants and terminal events. Implement normal completion and cancellation separately. Test a zero-result inquiry as well as an extended result. `I:870,1567,1620–1647,1718`, `U:310–319`. |
| 9 | `0405`, peer feature reads, `0411`, `0413` and SSP events | Forward real link/security procedures. Validate the HCI→KE struct offsets and LC instance routing. Complete feature-page discovery, pass each SSP decision to Bluedroid once, and report genuine authentication and encryption outcomes. `F:893,930–948,1646–1683`, `A:435–436,1229–1246`, `S:5606,5624`. |
| 10 | `13` completed ACL packets, policy and flush terminal events | Forward real controller completions per handle and verify continuous transmission **beyond one full ACL window**. Then exercise idle→active sniff, role switch and enhanced flush with their terminal events. Returning command credit cannot replenish ACL credit or complete a mode transition. `F:817–832`, `U:385–393,479,2053–2061`, `stack/l2cap/l2c_api.c:2405–2415`. |
